expr = xmlFuzzReadString(&exprSize); xml = xmlFuzzReadString(&xmlSize); /* Recovery mode allows more input to be fuzzed. */ doc = xmlReadMemory(xml, xmlSize, NULL, NULL, XML_PARSE_RECOVER); if (doc != NULL) { xmlXPathContextPtr xpctxt = xmlXPathNewContext(doc);
